timing: After both fixed train fits completed; before any real development model score
aggregation: pool recordings within speaker-condition; equal weight all speaker-condition cells

transition.step_metric: first of3 consecutive outputs within50c of finalF0, acquisition e>=physicalstep; targetlag=e-20ms-step, availabilitydelay=e-step; no negative clamp
transition.glide_metric: median signed(analyticF0(t)-estimate)/slope on full-ramp-support frames; no negative clamp

selection: GRU only if every gate passes; otherwise MLP only if its independent gates pass; otherwise minimum-joint-error classical comparator with limitations; no automatic production integration
remaining_requirements: complete worker service runtime and explicit drop/coverage gate
subsequent confirmation and calibration gates before sealed-test claims
